info.name: ONRR CMS — GraphQL Queries
info.description:
All top-level GraphQL queries used by the Nuxt frontend, with fragments inlined so each is runnable.

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to the target Directus instance:
- Local: http://localhost:8056
- Upgrade: https://upgrade-onrr-cms.app.cloud.gov

Requests POST to `{{baseUrl}}/graphql`. Public (unauthenticated) read is assumed; add an Authorization: Bearer <token> header on the collection if you need private data.

Generated from app/graphql/queries/**.gql.

graphql.query:
query GetChartCardByKey($key: String!) {
  chart_cards(filter: { key: { _eq: $key } }, limit: 1) {
    ...chartCardFields
  }
}

fragment chartCardFields on chart_cards {
  id
  title
  key
  source
  # chart configuration
  chart_type
  render_mode
  stacking
  takeaway
  takeaway_variables
  # data source (collection aggregation)
  data_source_type
  source_collection
  aggregate_function
  aggregate_field
  group_by_field
  filter
  endpoint_url
  x_axis_field
  static_data
  # axes
  x_axis_label
  y_axis_label
  x_axis_type
  x_axis_format
  tick_interval
  y_axis_min
  y_axis_max
  y_tick_interval
  y_axis_secondary_label
  # styling / interaction
  grid_columns
  color_palette
  background_color
  height
  show_legend
  legend_position
  show_data_labels
  show_tooltip
  enable_export
  enable_zoom
  # table options
  table_category_label
  table_include_category
  table_show_totals
  table_totals_direction
  table_default_sort
  table_sort_direction
  # advanced escape hatch
  highcharts_config
  # per-series definitions
  series {
    id
    sort
    name
    type
    color
    y_axis
    data_field
    stack_group
    value_format
    prefix
    suffix
    dash_style
    marker_enabled
    visible
    static_data
  }
  __typename
}
